descriptions.normal: An everyday Inazuman dish. The sliced Egg Roll is placed over seasoned rice. Simply made, yet full of flavor.
descriptions.suspicious: An everyday Inazuman dish. The egg roll was not beaten evenly and the vinegared rice was also over-seasoned... Even simple dishes leave no room for carelessness.
descriptions.delicious: An everyday Inazuman dish. The tender egg bounces on the tongue together with the rich grains, bringing to mind a joy that recalls one's childhood. Eager to relive that sweetness, you pick up another before your brain can even catch up.

effectTexts.normal: Restores 9% of Max HP and an additional 1,000 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.suspicious: Restores 8% of Max HP and an additional 800 HP to the selected character.
effectTexts.delicious: Restores 10% of Max HP and an additional 1,200 HP to the selected character.
